visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a white sweatshirt and cap is at a store kiosk printing photos of a baby. She picks out various colorful frames from a shelf labeled with prices. (2) At home, hands are shown installing batteries into a white light-up letter 'O'. A man in a yellow shirt helps assemble light-up name letters 'ROSIE' on a table. (3) A series of quick cuts shows the unboxing and preparation of party supplies, including a plaid tablecloth, jars of colorful candy and lollipops, pastel-colored paper cups, and shiny pink decorations. (4) Several people work together in a brightly lit living room to hang a iridescent 'HAPPY BIRTHDAY' banner and set up a dessert table. Balloons in pastel blue, yellow, and pink are inflated and positioned. (5) The completed setup is shown with a rainbow '1' light, a colorful sprinkle cake on a green box, and various gifts wrapped in blue and floral paper. A wall is decorated with baby photos clipped to fairy lights. (6) A woman in a pink striped sweater walks through a decorative curtain into the room, looking surprised and laughing. She joins a man holding a baby girl in a beige dress as they are surrounded by family and friends taking photos with their phones. (7) The family poses behind the birthday table for photos while the baby looks at the camera. (8) The baby is placed on a pink mat on the floor surrounded by traditional objects like a stethoscope, a calculator, and a mini piano for a 'Zhuazhou' ceremony. A phone on a tripod records the baby as she crawls towards the items.
